title: 636017 Move Sales report action tooltips to report objects
summary: Sales report action tooltips are moved from page actions to the report objects themselves, eliminating duplicates across role centers and pages where these reports are invoked.
key_points: ToolTips for 5 Sales reports now live on the report objects instead of the page actions that run them
Duplicate action tooltips removed from 9 W1 pages and role centers, including CRM and Finance role centers
Country layers updated: 3 report fork additions and 52 page fork removals across 18 layers
Page actions inherit the report tooltip via the 2025 release wave 1 UI descriptor defaulting feature
Metadata-only change that completes the Sales area
quote: Moves the report action ToolTips for 5 Sales reports off the page actions that run them and onto the report objects themselves.
